# Donor-Aware Single-Cell eQTL Workflow

## Objective

Simulate cells from genotyped donors and benchmark cell-type eQTLs using donor-by-cell-type pseudobulk, avoiding pseudoreplication.

```r
library(simitall)

sc <- simulate_scrnaseq_from_gwas(
  genotype_file = "results/gwas/cohort.geno.tsv",
  out_prefix = "results/scrna/gwas_linked",
  cells_per_donor = 200,
  cell_type_eqtl_fraction = 0.4,
  doublet_rate = 0.03,
  seed = 505
)

benchmark_celltype_eqtls(
  genotype_file = "results/gwas/cohort.geno.tsv",
  pseudobulk_expression = sc$pseudobulk_expression,
  pseudobulk_metadata = sc$pseudobulk_metadata,
  truth_file = sc$eqtl_truth,
  out_prefix = "results/scrna/eqtl"
)
plot_scrnaseq_results(
  scrna_prefix = "results/scrna/gwas_linked",
  eqtl_prefix = "results/scrna/eqtl",
  out_prefix = "results/figures/scrna"
)
```

## Rule

Cells are observations nested within donors. The donor, not the cell, is the biological replication unit for genotype association.
